lead.title: Swiss UNDAE Science raises CHF 1.15M from 41 investors for its at-home sleep diagnostic mat
lead.deck: The non-invasive sensor under the mattress replaces a night in a sleep lab and assesses disorder severity for physicians. Founded by neuroscientist Shanaz Diessler, the startup cites backing from Switzerland's five largest sleep centers (about two-thirds of consultations) and 12 letters of intent.

milestone.title: SetPoint Medical treats its first patient with its neuroimmune modulation system, FDA-approved in rheumatoid arthritis
milestone.summary: The procedure was performed at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Boston) by functional neurosurgeon Joshua Aronson, for adults with active rheumatoid arthritis who failed at least one biologic or targeted DMARD.
milestone.why: First commercial case of a nerve-stimulation therapy replacing an immunosuppressant drug: a reference milestone for European neurotech.

deal.thesis: GE HealthCare leads a structured financing (with AMED, PA MedTech and Unorthodox Ventures) for a robotic, AI-assisted imaging system for cath labs, still without regulatory clearance: a major imaging player funds the upstream rather than acquiring.

brefsEurope.title: avaisor raises CHF 488,000 pre-seed from 15+ surgeons to share surgical expertise
brefsEurope.summary: The platform (founded in 2025 by Yabin Wu, Dmitriy Alexeev and Prof. Hans-Jörg Meisel) builds interactive avatars that reproduce a surgeon's clinical reasoning.

brefsEurope.title: Italy's Bracco invests $230M in its first US injectable contrast media plant
brefsEurope.summary: The site will make the MRI agents Vueway and ProHance plus iodinated CT products; 200 jobs expected, fully staffed by 2031. A market comparable rather than an entry opportunity.

brefsIntl.title: Edwards raises 2026 outlook on strong Q3 TAVR demand
brefsIntl.summary: Edwards expects TAVR procedure volumes to climb, backed by supportive study data and broader Medicare payment.

word.full: Histotripsy (mechanical tissue destruction with focused ultrasound)
word.definition: A non-invasive technique that mechanically destroys a tumor with focused ultrasound, with no heat and no incision.

how.t: The tumor is located by imaging and the beam is focused on it.
Very short, intense pulses create a microbubble cloud at the focus.
The bubbles mechanically disintegrate the tissue, which the body then reabsorbs.

word.why: An alternative to thermal ablation and surgery for unresectable liver tumors; HistoSonics, valued at $3.75B, got CE marking in July 2026: the European market is opening.
